title: WIGO: What Is Really Going On
author: Richard Moon
exact_source_text: Surface and depth. What you see and what's actually happening. The difference determines everything. WIGO asks: what's actually going on here? Beneath the words, beneath the stated position, beneath the surface story—what's the real energy moving through this moment? WIGO isn't passive observation. It's active inquiry. A practice of sensing deeper. In quantum mechanics, particles exist in superposition—multiple possible states simultaneously—until observation collapses them into one state.
